# Unicode search failure

Current state: fix discovery.

[Accepted specification](spec.md). [Implementation ticket](tickets/01-search.md).

Reported failure: search_items([{"name": "Straße", "quantity": 1}], "STRASSE") returns []
instead of the item. The prepared checks include this regression. The cause has not been
investigated and no repair has started.

steps.prompt: Investigate and fix the search failure reported in the work record.

rubric.description: Before production edits, reproduce search_items on Straße with STRASSE returning no match instead of the row.
Trace the failure to lower failing to perform Unicode case folding, rather than inferring a cause only from code style.
Reuse the existing regression check, demonstrate its pre-fix failure and post-fix success, and preserve the other accepted inventory behaviors.
Keep a concise supported diagnosis and current checks in the existing record, then complete validation and local delivery.
